prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection: Reorder the flow so users pick and customize their pet before signing in to build commitment. (why: Sign in currently happens upfront before users bond with a pet, causing sign-in friction and drop-off.)
1: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough: Redesign home_intro into a spotlight layout with interactive desktop control tryouts. (why: Support receives multiple emails from users confused about how to hide, summon, or talk to their pet after setup.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Recovery Notice: Add clear sign-in hint explaining that signing into an existing account restores previously adopted pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
3: [home, wait_info] Interactive Tips During Generation Wait: Add tip carousel, time estimate, and progress bar to waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step (home) takes a median 201s and mean 2336s, leaving users wondering if the app froze.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Setup Time Estimate on Story Screen: Set clear time expectations and add time estimate badge on the story screen. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s, indicating drop-offs due to unmanaged time expectations.)

scores.note: Sign-in loses 27% of users; reordering builds upfront commitment but lacks support email evidence.
Finish step loses 35% and support emails confirm post-setup confusion, though redesign requires new screens.
Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in drop-off; cheap copy update.
